banner.title: The UA promotion batch two - rounds R349 through R359 complete - the Unearthed Arcana set open
banner.provenance: The UA promotion arc round two, the second rules promotion batch from the Unearthed Arcana pin rounds: eleven records promoted into content/rules/ua/ - rounds R349 through R359 complete (the cleric 7th-level spell block, the druid spell blocks 1st through 7th, the magic-user spell blocks' opening), one record per round per the OA header-record doctrine (the pin header stays the adjudicated record; the multi-header rounds merge their headers' pools), 1201 model items (consts, bools, switches, chains), every record parsed back and compared equal (the lossless proof), the audit conditions converted to bad-detector examples. This batch is 278958 bytes of Lua. Cumulative twenty-four of the 76-round UA set, 52 rounds remaining.
